defeats.how: Kingpin's enforcer Nurse Lois broke Urich's fingers and beat Manolis nearly to death to stop Manolis confessing.
defeats.evidence: breaking Urich's fingers and beating Manolis nearly to death

defeats.how: Lois broke into Manolis's hospital room and strangled him, laying the phone receiver on his bed so Urich heard the murder.
defeats.evidence: Lois breaks into his room and strangles him
